description: Put the link of a handoff seal you made on the user's clipboard again (or in its 0600 file), by its handle: for a link that was lost before it reached the recipient. You never get the link itself. Seals of mode inbox are in the user's inbox, and forward links came back to you: neither has one here.

handle.description: Handle of a handoff seal from seal_share or seal_list.

name: seal_link
title: Hand over a seal link again
